scope: Actual source controller + pure routing/camera/delivery helpers in Node with deferred promises; static HTML assertions. Not native browser, GPU or real mobile verification.

cases.name: Only the newest image decode commits image, title identity and downloads
Failed image never relabels previous image or changes download identity
A stale image failure does not change status of the latest successful route
Cancel pending parse, then restart: stale scene releases only itself
Context loss does not cancel an independent pending image route
Offline during pending route commits new image without restarting 3D
Repeated activation aborts earlier fetch and only latest parse attaches
Destroy invalidates both lifetimes and rejects new work
A stale GPU failure cannot cancel an independent pending image route
Current GPU initialization failure preserves route and releases parsed scene
3D cannot activate before the first successful image commit
Activation during image decode is invalidated again at the atomic route commit
Late parse from activation during pending route cannot attach after new image commits
Requested view, history context and final route identity commit together
Views of same variant do not accept old GLB callbacks from the previous camera session
Deep-link parsing rejects unknown variants and unsafe view paths
Raw Blender delivery labels and paths are independent per variant
Camera conversion is metre preserving and uses metadata view, not a replacement scene
Static HTML has all real images and 16 raw download entries without requiring JS
